policy.primaryKeys: Use original canonical IDs only. Never geocode or consolidate same-named churches automatically.
policy.images: Approved local image only; missing images are a sourcing queue, not free media or an invitation to scrape copyrighted photos.
policy.claims: Liturgical events, miracles, apparition recognition, architectural attribution and founding dates require original cited publisher evidence.
policy.calendar: Annual pilgrimage dates are source claims, not automatically 1962 Calendar observances or a live timetable.
policy.participation: A destination pilgrimage does not imply a mapped certified walking route.
policy.updates: Regenerate this coverage index from canonical records whenever a guide or photo is accepted.
